success_patterns: When flights and hotels are requested for the same trip, the stated flight destination can supply the hotel city, leaving only missing stay dates to clarify.

patch.reasoning: Two trajectories request hotels alongside a flight itinerary and omit a separate hotel location; both proceed to clarify dates without treating the hotel city as missing. Making this inference explicit can avoid unnecessary clarification while keeping it limited to clearly linked trip lodging.

edits.target: Flight searches require a known route and departure date; hotel searches require a city, check-in date, and checkout date; restaurant searches require a city.
edits.content: When hotels are requested as part of the same trip as a flight with a known destination, use that destination as the hotel city unless the user specifies a different lodging location.
